items.title: Hacking the AOHi 280W 6 Port USB Charger for fun and Rick Rolls
items.description: In this video we take a look at and inside of the AOHi 280W Charger AOC-C022 in quite some length. The Desktop charger feature 4 USB-C and 2 USB-A Ports as well as a Wifi Interface that is configured via a BLE connection and allows to set and reads its config and Power draw. The outcome of the look inside a fully replacing custom firmware which replicates the stock firmware by 95% and gives some extra feature like a history diagram. Find the full source-code in this GitHub Repository: https://github.com/atc1441/AOHi_280W_Charger_Hacking Follow me on twitter: https://twitter.com/atc1441

items.title: Fully Hacking DOOM onto the MiBand 9 / 10 Full Quad-SPI Display driving
items.description: This video continues the Hacking on the MiBand 9 / 10 and now allows to fully play DOOM with around 36 fps and full colors. In the previous video: https://youtu.be/XdoPEcibQdg The display driver was still quite buggy and only did allow to use 8bit colors and single Line SPI Driving. Find the GitHub Repository here: https://github.com/atc1441/MiBand10-BES2700iMP-BEST1503-Hacking And the previous videos about the Teardown of the MiBand 9: https://youtu.be/BjN_QfSacsc And 10: https://youtu.be/QmVwbeRdpVA And of course Doom on the MiBand 8: https://youtu.be/iqyR_LNp9vc Follow me on Twitter: https://x.com/atc1441
